spans.s: दाक्ष a. southern or belonging to Dakṣa.
द॑क्षकन्या f. Dakṣa's daughter.
1 दक्षक्रतु॑ m. du. will and intellect.
2 द॑क्षक्रतु a. having a strong intellect.
द॑क्षत् a. gleaming, glittering.
दक्षता f. ability, dexterity, cleverness.

द॑क्षपितृ a. having Dakṣa as father or gifted with
cleverness.
द॑क्षस् a. able, strong, clever.
दक्षसुत m. आ f. son & daughter of Dakṣa.
दक्षा॑य्य a. to be obeyed or pleased.
दक्षिणा॑ adv. on the right or on the south of (abl.).
दाक्षिण॑ a. belonging to a sacrificial gift.

दक्षिणत॑स् adv. from the right or the south;
 on the
right side or south of (gen.). With कृ turn the right to a person (as
a mark of esteem).
दक्षिणत्रा॑ adv. on the right side.
दक्षिणत्व n. honesty, amiableness.

दक्षिणपवन m. the south-wind^1.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
दक्षिणपश्चिम a. south-western.
दक्षिणपूर्व a. south-eastern.
दक्षिणात् (abl. adv.) from or on the right or south.

दक्षिणापथ m. the Dekhan (lit. southern path or
country).
दक्षिणापर a. south-western.
दक्षिणाप्रत्यञ्च् f. ˚तीची south-western.
दक्षिणा॑प्रवण a. sloping to the south.
दक्षिणाभिमुख a. facing or flowing southwards.

दक्षिणायन n. the southern progress (of the sun), the
summer.
दक्षिणारण्य n. the southern forest.
दक्षिणावर्त m. = दक्षिणापथ.
दक्षिणाशिरस् a. turning the head towards the south.
दक्षिणावृ॑त् a. turned or going round towards the right.

*दक्षिणाहि adv. far on the right or in the south of
(abl.).
दक्षिणी@कृ = दक्षिणं@कृ.
दक्षिणी॑य a. worthy of the sacrificial fee.
दक्षिणेतर a. other than right, left.
द॑क्षिणेन (instr. adv.) = दक्षिणा॑, w. acc.
दक्षिणैस् (instr. pl. adv.) on the right side.
दक्षिणोत्तर a. right and left, south and north.
दक्षिण्य॑ = दक्षिणी॑य.
द॑क्षु a. burning.
दक्षु॑स् a. burning.

दाक्षायण॑ f. ई descended from or belonging to Dakṣa;
m. n. a cert. sacrifice.
दाक्षिण्यवन्त् a. kind, polite, amiable.
दाक्ष्य n. dexterity, shrewdness, skill, industry.
